content:
maria: FYI console showed a customer with a tiny streaming request get a -12 provisional token line after a region handoff.
kevin: yikes. can you drop logs or screenshot?
maria: screenshot posted. logs: 
```
2026-03-12T18:02:10Z router: session=s-213 route=us-west-2 -> eu-west-1 reason=burst_failover
2026-03-12T18:02:10Z runtime: session=s-213 prefix_len=22 tokens_emitted=28 status=stream
2026-03-12T18:02:11Z runtime: session=s-213 toolcall=pdf_ocr truncated=true tokens_tool=6
2026-03-12T18:02:13Z router: session=s-213 ack=resume confirmed=true
2026-03-12T18:02:13Z billing: session=s-213 provisional_delta=-12
```
Seems provisional credited on origin shard but the reconcile adjust ended up on the final shard.
sam: we already dedupe retries by session+seq but maybe provenance lost during handoff?
kevin: router currently replaces route_tag on handoff. ledger keys = route_tag + session_prefix. if route_tag changes we touch two shards.
irene: runtime does carry request-trace-id, but billing events don't use it.
ben: result: origin shard shows negative provisional, final shard gets refund, console surfaces only origin so support tickets escalate.
maria: customer saw weird negative row and our auto-refund triggered. bad UX.
kevin: short-term: have router attach X-Orig-Route on handoff and include that in billing writes so ledger can merge by provenance before reconcile.
sam: ledger idempotency key = session|prefix|orig_route should work. low risk?
irene: keep in mind analytics: we must still attribute final confirmed cost to final route for dashboards. provenance should only be for dedupe.
kevin: plan: 1) router: set X-Orig-Route on handoff (1d) 2) runtime: propagate trace id to billing (0.5d) 3) ledger: idempotency key + merge provisional creates (2d) 4) reconcile: emit confirmed cost with final_route tag + audit record (2d) 5) console: label provisional rows and link reconcile trace (1d). total ~6d.
ben: ops-bot: incident created INC-2026-042 assigned eng-platform. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: canary router change at 10%. logs show X-Orig-Route preserved in ~95% of handoffs.
maria: UI mitigation: hide negative provisional rows or label them "pending adjustment" and link to trace while we roll. I'll submit a quick PR.
kevin: I'll open router PR with tests for header preservation and add a sim to reproduce.
sam: I'll add unit test for the edgecase where toolcall truncated event is logged on old shard then final ack on new shard. ensure idempotency unifies both.
irene: also add alert: if net negative provisional > X tokens across any shard in 5m, page ops.
ben: summary: root cause = route_tag mutation on handoff + ledger keyed by route_tag. fix = provenance header + ledger idempotency + reconcile audit and console UX.
maria: I'll add support template for customers who hit this while we roll. cc @kevin for router PR.
kevin: tracking PRs: router r/3498, ledger r/3501, console r/3502, tests r/3503.
ben: incident marked monitoring; will close when canary at 100% and reconcile shows <1 negative/min.
ops-bot: incident INC-2026-042 status: monitoring.
